newsitem.title: BURUNDI: Burundi ex-president Bagaza very ill, says family.
newsitem.headline: Burundi ex-president Bagaza very ill, says family.

text.p: Burundi's ex-president Jean-Baptiste Bagaza, under house arrest because of a dispute with military leader Pierre Buyoya, is "critically" ill, family members said on Thursday.

"Bagaza's health is critical and nobody has visited him. He is completely isolated and cut off from all means of communication. Doctors have gone to see him and demanded he be taken to the hospital," said a close relative who requested anonymity.

Buyoya, who took power in a coup last July, announced last month a pre-ceasefire agreement with the main Hutu rebel group, the National Council for the Defence of Democracy, aimed at ending Burundi's bitter civil war in which more than 150,000 people have died since October 1993.
But Bagaza and other leading ethnic Tutsis fiercely oppose talks, arguing it is wrong to talk to Hutu rebels they say are bent on genocide.
